title: Character card
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: The Rightly Guided Caliphs: Uthman and Ali
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y6 lesson 26 (Pupil PDF worksheet: character card)
intro: Lesson 26: Ali's justice and character. To understand how Ali (رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُ) showed justice, humility and a simple life, and what we can copy

questions.q: Explain why the name Abu Turab was special to Ali.
questions.a: The Prophet ﷺ gave it to him kindly when he found him covered in dust.
questions.model: Point: it was a name of love. Evidence: the Prophet ﷺ said 'get up, Abu Turab' (Bukhari and Muslim). Explain: Ali treasured anything the Prophet ﷺ gave him.

questions.q: Write a 'character card' for Ali in the portal response box: three qualities, each with an example, and one you will copy this week. Start: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib showed ...'
questions.a: Three qualities with examples and a personal target
questions.model: Teacher writes: 'Ali showed humility: he did not mind being called Abu Turab, father of dust.'

questions.q: why would a just leader live simply?
questions.a: So he does not use people's money for himself

questions.q: what can we learn from how Ali faced hard times?
questions.a: Patience and trying to keep people united

questions.q: Back to our ponder: why trust a leader who lives simply?
questions.a: He is not ruling for himself; it shows justice
